title.zh-CN: 反复头痛、眩晕与走路不稳
title.en: Recurrent headache, dizziness and unsteady walking

summary.zh-CN: 青年患者反复出现后循环样症状，先后影像表现并不一致，需要按时间解释血管变化。
summary.en: A young adult has recurrent posterior-circulation symptoms with changing vascular appearances over time.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: AHA/ASA 2021 secondary stroke prevention guideline, verified 2026-10-28; scope homocysteine supplementation does not establish prevention of recurrent stroke.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

openingLine.zh-CN: 三个月前头痛、眩晕，走路不稳并有左侧肢体无力。

text.zh-CN: MRI显示右小脑梗死。首次DSA示左椎动脉颅内段5×2 mm动脉瘤，右小脑上/后下动脉起始段及左大脑后动脉狭窄。
text.en: MRI showed a right cerebellar infarct. Initial DSA demonstrated a 5×2 mm intracranial left vertebral aneurysm and stenoses at right superior/posterior inferior cerebellar origins and the left posterior cerebral artery.

prompt.en: Which interpretation best fits the early records?

text.zh-CN: 后循环缺血伴多处颅内血管异常，需要解释机制
text.en: Posterior-circulation ischaemia with multiple intracranial vascular abnormalities requiring mechanistic assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 小脑梗死及造影异常提供器质性证据。
feedback.en: The cerebellar infarct and angiographic abnormalities provide structural evidence.

text.zh-CN: 年龄小，所以只是功能性眩晕
text.en: Young age makes this functional dizziness alone

feedback.zh-CN: 年龄不能否定已记录的梗死。
feedback.en: Age cannot negate a documented infarct.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭同型半胱氨酸即可确立全部病因
text.en: Homocysteine alone establishes the complete cause

feedback.zh-CN: 升高是关联证据，不能证明全部狭窄和动脉瘤由它引起。
feedback.en: Elevation is associative evidence and does not prove the cause of every vascular lesion.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 动脉瘤不显影与基底动脉闭塞并存，不能等同血管病已治愈
text.en: Loss of aneurysm filling coexists with basilar occlusion and is not vascular cure

feedback.zh-CN: 需把供血重构和闭塞放在同一时间线，来源提出的机制仍属解释。
feedback.en: Reconfigured supply and occlusion must be interpreted together; proposed mechanisms remain interpretations.

text.zh-CN: 动脉瘤消失即可停止所有血管随访
text.en: Disappearance of the aneurysm permits ending vascular follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 这忽略了新发现的主要动脉闭塞。
feedback.en: This ignores the newly documented major arterial occlusion.

text.zh-CN: 已经证实具体遗传性代谢病
text.en: A specific inherited metabolic disease is proven

feedback.zh-CN: 原文未提供相关基因检测。
feedback.en: The report supplied no relevant genetic testing.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前教学计划应强调什么？
prompt.en: What should the present-day educational plan emphasise?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 神经血管专科评估病因和二级预防，个体化随访并评估营养代谢因素
text.en: Neurovascular review of aetiology and secondary prevention, individualised follow-up and metabolic/nutritional assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 补充维生素不能取代对已发生卒中及闭塞的系统管理。
feedback.en: Vitamin supplementation cannot replace systematic management after stroke and arterial occlusion.

text.zh-CN: 保证维生素治疗可以防止再次卒中

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明反复症状有梗死及血管影像依据。；承认没有完整病因筛查、遗传检测和长期结局。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Recurrent symptoms have infarct and vascular imaging correlates.; acknowledge Complete aetiological investigation, genetic testing and long-term outcome are unavailable. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 年轻患者后循环梗死、多发血管狭窄及动脉瘤样改变并存，后续出现基底动脉闭塞与原瘤不显影。
conclusion.en: A young patient had posterior-circulation infarction, multiple stenoses and an aneurysmal lesion, followed by basilar occlusion and loss of aneurysm filling.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 反复症状有梗死及血管影像依据。
keyReasoning.en: Recurrent symptoms have infarct and vascular imaging correlates.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 同型半胱氨酸升高不能独立证明因果。
keyReasoning.en: Homocysteine elevation alone does not establish causation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 不显影须结合其他血管和侧支供血解读。
keyReasoning.en: Non-opacification requires interpretation alongside other vessels and collateral supply.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 比较连续影像的实际变化。
teachingPoints.en: Compare the actual changes in sequential imaging.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 区分危险因素与已证实病因。
teachingPoints.en: Distinguish risk factors from proven causes.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 历史维生素处方不构成现代预防保证。
teachingPoints.en: Historical vitamins do not guarantee modern prevention.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 没有完整病因筛查、遗传检测和长期结局。
unknowns.en: Complete aetiological investigation, genetic testing and long-term outcome are unavailable.
